components.name: address-cta
components.purpose: Address box that sends the reader to catering search for their address; use near the top and end of a page.

props.name: headline
props.description: Bold line above the address box, e.g. "Find retirement party catering near you".

props.name: subhead
props.description: Smaller line under the headline.

props.name: note
props.description: Short reassurance line under the box, e.g. "Office lunches · Buffets · On-time delivery guarantee".

props.name: forward-to
props.description: Search results page the address is sent to. Add filters to it, e.g. /search?package_type=breakfast.

props.name: cta
props.description: Button text.

props.name: background
props.description: Box color: none, warm (cream with a peach border), or blue with white text.

example.markdown:
::address-cta
---
headline: Find baby shower catering near you
subhead: Enter the shower's delivery address to see brunch spreads, platters and finger foods from vetted local restaurants.
note: Brunch spreads · Platters & trays · On-time delivery guarantee
forward-to: /search?search_type=packages&h1=Baby+Shower+Catering+Near+You
---
::

components.name: callout
components.purpose: Highlighted note or tip set apart from the body text.

props.name: title
props.description: Small uppercase label above the text, e.g. "Pro tip".

components.name: caterers
components.purpose: Live list of CaterCow caterers matching a search URL.

props.name: search-url
props.description: Paste a catercow.com search URL to show the caterers it finds. Empty shows popular caterers near the visitor.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many caterers to show.

props.name: button-text
props.description: Text for a button under the list that opens the full search. Leave empty for no button.

props.name: small
props.description: Smaller logo tiles.

props.name: hide-names
props.description: Show logos only, without caterer names.

components.name: chipotle-cost-calculator
components.purpose: Interactive calculator estimating Chipotle catering cost by metro and headcount. No props.

components.name: cta-banner
components.purpose: Banner with text and one button linking to a CaterCow page; the main call to action.

props.name: to
props.description: Where the button goes: a site path like /get-started, or a full URL.

props.name: cta
props.description: Button label.

components.name: facts-grid
components.purpose: Grid of short label/value facts, such as an at-a-glance summary.

props.name: items
props.description: One card per fact.

example.markdown:
::facts-grid
---
items:
  - label: Starting Price
    value: "From $39.99 per platter"
  - label: Lead Time
    value: 24 hours (made fresh to order)
  - label: Membership Required
    value: Yes — Club or Club+ tier
  - label: Format
    value: In-club pickup
---
::

components.name: faqs
components.purpose: Frequently asked questions. Write each question as a ### heading inside the block and its answer under it. The page also publishes them to search engines as FAQ structured data, so keep answers accurate.

example.markdown:
::faqs
### How do I redeem the RHTBOS50 coupon code?

Enter `RHTBOS50` at checkout on the [Red Heat Tavern catering page](https://www.catercow.com/brands/9310). The $50 discount applies automatically to orders of $200 or more.

### What's the minimum order for Red Heat Tavern catering?

The $50 coupon requires a $200 order subtotal. A single tray of Roasted Steak Tips ($160) plus a side and dessert clears it; a Hearty Comfort Classics Buffet for 14 people lands you there too.

### Which areas does Red Heat Tavern deliver to?

With five locations across Bedford MA, Milford MA, Westborough MA, Wilmington MA, and South Windsor CT, they cover the greater Boston area, MetroWest, Worcester, and the Hartford metro for office catering. Enter your office address in CaterCow to see which kitchen serves you and your delivery radius.

### How far in advance do I need to order?

Lead time is 20 hours for most orders. For larger events with multiple trays or special dietary needs, we recommend at least 24 hours.
::

components.name: food-truck-cost-calculator
components.purpose: Interactive calculator estimating food truck catering cost. No props.

components.name: gallery
components.purpose: Rows of images shown side by side.

props.name: rows
props.description: Each row is shown side by side on wide screens and stacked on phones. Write the caption inside the block.

example.markdown:
::gallery
---
rows:
  - - src: /blog/to-the-boss-ladies-of-the-catering-world/sajj1.jpg
      alt: ""
---
Santa Berzina with her team volunteering at Second Harvest Food Bank
::

props.name: url
props.description: The post's link (Share → Copy link), e.g. https://www.instagram.com/p/DMd8x-TRioJ/

props.name: caption
props.description: Shown until Instagram's script replaces the box.

example.markdown:
::instagram-post
---
url: https://www.instagram.com/p/DMd8x-TRioJ/
caption: A post shared by The Hapeville Dwarf House (@thedwarfhouse)
---
::

components.name: logo-strip
components.purpose: Row of customer or partner logos, from a preset or a custom list.

props.name: preset
props.description: "customers" shows the standard CaterCow customer logos; "custom" shows the logos listed below.

props.name: logos
props.description: Logos to show when preset is "custom".

items.name: src
items.description: Logo image URL (SVG or a transparent PNG works best).

items.name: alt
items.description: The company name, for screen readers.

items.name: href
items.description: Optional link when the logo is clicked.

components.name: packages
components.purpose: Live list of CaterCow catering packages matching a search.

props.name: search-url
props.description: Paste a catercow.com search URL to show the same results (its filters win over the fields below).

props.name: limit
props.description: How many packages to show.

props.name: button-text
props.description: Text for a button under the list that opens the full search. Leave empty for no button.

props.name: package-type
props.description: Meal type.

props.name: package-category
props.description: Cuisine category key, e.g. "lunch_mexican" (the same key the catering guide front matter uses).

props.name: presentation-type
props.description: Show only individually wrapped meals, or only buffet-style.

props.name: show-pagination
props.description: Add page links when there are more results than the limit.

components.name: pricing-grid
components.purpose: Grid of menu items with counts, prices, per-person prices and descriptions.

props.name: items
props.description: One card per item.

items.name: count
items.description: Second line under the name, e.g. "Serves 10".

items.name: tag
items.description: Badge above the name, e.g. "Most popular".

example.markdown:
::pricing-grid
---
items:
  - name: The Classic Breakfast Egg Burrito Pack
    price: 11.50
    description: 10 Classic Breakfast Burritos with scrambled eggs, Jack cheese, and fillings. Feeds 10. ($115.00 total.)
    tag: Insider Pick
---
::

components.name: promo-codes
components.purpose: Table of promo codes, one row per location, with copy buttons and fine print.

props.name: items
props.description: One row per code.

items.name: label
items.description: Where the code applies, e.g. a city.

items.name: url
items.description: Optional link for the label, e.g. the city's catering page.

props.name: label-heading
props.description: Heading for the first column.

props.name: code-heading
props.description: Heading for the code column, e.g. "Code for a $100 Panera Gift Card".

example.markdown:
::promo-codes
---
label-heading: Area
code-heading: Code for a $100 Wawa Gift Card
items:
  - label: New York City & North Jersey
    url: https://www.catercow.com/explore/new-york-city/cuisines/sandwich-catering
    code: 100OFFWAWANYC
  - label: Washington, DC Area
    url: https://www.catercow.com/explore/washington-dc/cuisines/sandwich-catering
    code: 100OFFWAWADC
---
Valid on your first CaterCow order of $100+ through March 31, 2027. Gift card arrives by email in about two weeks.
::

components.name: reviews
components.purpose: Live CaterCow customer reviews, optionally for one brand or package.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many reviews to show.

props.name: brand-id
props.description: Only reviews of this caterer (brand ID from the admin). Empty shows recent reviews across CaterCow.

props.name: package-id
props.description: Only reviews of this package (package ID from the admin).

props.name: show-google-rating
props.description: Show CaterCow's Google rating badge above the reviews.

components.name: tips
components.purpose: Numbered tips in two columns. Write each tip as a ### heading inside the block with its text under it; each heading starts a new card.

example.markdown:
::tips
### Stack Dunkin' Rewards

The Dunkin' Rewards program earns points on most in-store and app orders, including large dozen-boxes and Box O' Joe. If you're the one regularly ordering for the team, route the orders through your own Rewards account — a 20-person breakfast run can earn you a free drink, and the points roll over.

### Call ahead for 5+ dozen

The online ordering flow caps at 3 dozen donuts. For anything bigger, the recommended approach is to phone the store the day before, ask to speak with the morning manager, and confirm a pickup time. Walking in cold with a 5-dozen request will get you waited on, but you'll wait — and you might not get your first-choice flavors.
::

components.name: video-block
components.purpose: Embedded video with an optional poster image and caption.

props.name: url
props.description: A YouTube or Vimeo link (any form, including share links), or a direct .mp4 URL.

props.name: caption
props.description: Text shown under the video.

props.name: poster
props.description: Still image shown before an .mp4 plays. Ignored for YouTube and Vimeo.
